title: Your shuffled deck is probably unique

probes.question: Roughly how many different orders can a 52-card deck be in?

image.alt: U.S. Air Force civilian Pierre Flatowicz, 55th Force Support Squadron, shuffles a deck of cards inside Building C on Offutt Air Force Base, Neb., Sept. 13. Flatowicz best finish in a national tourname
image.credit: U.S. Air Force photo by Charles Haymond / Wikimedia Commons

body.claim: Any two properly shuffled decks of 52 cards are almost certain to be in different orders.
body.why: There are 52! ways to order a deck, about 8 × 10^67. With that many possible orders, two properly shuffled decks matching is almost impossible.
